name: notely
description: Notely — personal stealth meeting assistant (Tauri 2 + React + Gemini). Local-only, single Gemini API key.

scripts.app:build: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && ([ -d /Applications/Notely.app/Contents/MacOS ] || cp -R src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Notely.app /Applications/) && cp src-tauri/target/release/notely /Applications/Notely.app/Contents/MacOS/notely && codesign --force --deep --sign - --identifier 'com.notely.desktop' --requirements '=designated => identifier "com.notely.desktop"' --entitlements src-tauri/entitlements.mac.plist /Applications/Notely.app
scripts.app:run: npm run app:build && (killall notely 2>/dev/null || true) && open /Applications/Notely.app
